descriptionChirho: Ministry, service, or attendance to a duty, encompassing both apostolic commission and practical serving. All 34 NT occurrences (Lk 10:40; Acts 1:17, 25, 6:1, 4, 11:29, 12:25, 20:24, 21:19; Rom 11:13, 12:7, 15:31; 1 Cor 12:5, 16:15; 2 Cor 3:7-9, 4:1, 5:18, 6:3, 8:4, 9:1, 12-13, 11:8; Eph 4:12; Col 4:17; 1 Tim 1:12; 2 Tim 4:5, 11; Heb 1:14; Rev 2:19) share uniform cross-linguistic translations: arb khidma (service), deu Dienst (service/duty), fra service, heb sherut (service/ministry), hin seva/sevkai (service/ministry), kor saygim/saryok/bongsa (serving/ministry/service), spa ministerio/servicio. The auto-clusters separated 'ministry' from 'service' and inflectional variants, but these represent a single lexical sense spanning the spectrum from Martha's table-serving (Lk 10:40) through relief aid (Acts 11:29) to Paul's apostolic commission (2 Cor 3-5), all unified by the core concept of active service performed for others.
